title: Three annual KISDI survey waves
body: 2023 baseline → 2024 outcome / baseline → 2025 outcome; Baseline privacy hesitation and next-wave linkage define the restricted cohorts

title: Development · 2023 → 2024
body: 1,565 respondents; 880 events; H + seven candidate information blocks

title: Select using development data
body: Ridge / HGB; item budgets 0–30; Five-fold tuning and portfolio selection; Original nested CV: 2 × 5 outer folds

title: Freeze, refit, and evaluate
body: Fit selected configurations on all development data; Assess whole and person-disjoint samples; Keep the full-information reference explicit

title: Two paired comparisons answer different questions
body: Incremental value: selected model versus P0 (H available) or NONE (H unavailable); Preservation: selected model versus the full-information model; Positive model-minus-reference log loss indicates worse prediction

title: Uncertainty and measurement checks
body: Paired fixed-fit bootstrap; full-process reselection; Calibration and within-period holdouts; Adjacent-service response diagnostics; Post hoc capital-region recoding

title: Added sensitivity analyses
body: Wider Ridge/HGB searches; random forest; extra trees; XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost; Full linked panel; weights; H+D already held; Block contributions, total and per item
